findings_summary: 0 CRITICAL, 1 HIGH, 3 MEDIUM — all foldable brief-amendments, no design breaks. HIGH (A8): DeleteMe must load the caller's orders via IgnoreQueryFilters keyed on CustomerUserId==sub — the CustomerOnly JWT has no fleet_id claim (CLAUDE.md WI-13), so a plain Orders.Where(o=>o.CustomerUserId==sub) hits the global query filter with null FleetId and anonymizes ZERO orders; pin with DeleteMe_OrdersRemainInReportsAnonymized. MEDIUM#2 (A5): ListFleets + the duplicate-slug 409 lookup need IgnoreQueryFilters (Fleet is tenant-scoped; 'cross-fleet by design' stated but mechanism unnamed). MEDIUM#3 (A3): GetRatings goal says 'in range' but files_touched has no GetRatingsRequest/validator — clarify rangeless OR add request+validator. MEDIUM#4 (A6): UploadLogo is POST-with-body but has no UploadLogoValidator; >200KB/non-PNG as endpoint guards is defensible for IFormFile (validation.md exempts non-trivial binding) — confirm intended, not a dropped validator.
verified_sound: All 7 novel risks sound. AC#2 SQL aggregation: A2/A3 GroupBy a Prague day key via date_trunc AT TIME ZONE → SQL (FromSql fallback still server-side), hours-online a SEPARATE bounded driver_shifts clamp-and-sum (not folded into the 50k GROUP BY), indexes in A1, 50k = a separate fleet-scoped idempotent ReportSeedScript (not the demo seeder) — no ToList-then-group. AC#7 CSV: pure Common/Reports/DriverReportCsv, UTF-8 BOM EF BB BF + ';' + CRLF, byte-test vs committed fixture, mid-day seed so tz cannot shift a bucket. AC#3 cross-tenant write: A5 POST admin/fleets is the SOLE cross-fleet write, SuperAdminOnly, sets scope CurrentTenant.FleetId to the NEW fleet (DevelopmentSeeder/WI-04 technique) so the SaveChanges guard passes, mandatory AdminFleets_Create_NonSuperAdmin_Returns403; CLI via testable SuperAdminBootstrapper + Program.cs args intercept before app.Run(). A4 audit: Concat→UNION ALL→OrderByDescending(At).ThenBy(Id).Skip().Take() as ONE paged set (not two independently-paged lists), in-memory fallback documented, jsonb never projected in SQL (WI-10), auto-tenant-scoped (both ITenantEntity). A7/A8: RetentionJob RunTickAsync shell + TimeProvider, 25mo anon / 23mo intact, shared CustomerAnonymizer (sentinel phone/name, order row kept) reused by A8. Migrations: A1 sole migration (5 indexes + Fleet.LogoUpdatedAt nullable), every other Lane-A WI depends_on A1. Multi-tenancy/logging: per-feature isolation tests, no PII beyond ids, client.ts named-envelope unwrap, RidesChart hand-rolled SVG (no chart dep). Source spot-checks: GetMySummaryEndpoint.GetDayWindow/PragueZone + FleetConfiguration.cs exist. No banned patterns; no missing DbSet.
disposition: Accept with 4 foldable amendments (1 HIGH + 3 MEDIUM) — proceed to implementation, no re-design. Folded into dev briefs: A8 IgnoreQueryFilters(CustomerUserId==sub) [HIGH correctness]; A5 IgnoreQueryFilters on ListFleets + slug-uniqueness lookup; A3 GetRatings rangeless-or-add-request+validator; A6 UploadLogo endpoint-guard confirmation. Persisted by the conductor (reviewer has no Write tool).
